meta.source: Hand-built from the Play Sweep logo kit (logo/build.py) and the current web and TV styles, 2026-11-26.

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Reel Orange. The logo symbol on dark grounds and the one fill colour for primary actions, active chips and progress. Text on it is always brand-teal (4.7:1); never white (2.8:1).

tokens.name: brand-orange-deep
tokens.usage: Deep Orange. The logo symbol on light grounds and the favicon. Not for text (3.7:1 on white).

tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: Cinema Teal. Wordmark on light, the header band, the app and TV icon tile, and text on orange fills.

tokens.name: brand-white
tokens.usage: Screen White. Wordmark on dark and the TV focus ring.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and TV screen background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the detail dialog, filter sheet. In dark it is Cinema Teal itself.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover and focused fills, segmented-control track, input fill. Keep orange text off it in dark (3.6:1); use fg.

tokens.name: poster-empty
tokens.usage: Poster and backdrop placeholder while artwork loads or is missing.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders (decorative, no contrast requirement).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (3.1:1 / 3.3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and surface-raised (11.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: release dates, runtime, overview, captions (5.1:1 or more on every surface).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button, active chip and tab underline, progress fill, selected state.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for accent elements (teal text 5.5:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange as text: kicker labels, links, the date in a hero (5.1:1 or more on bg and surface).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard and remote focus ring, drawn outside a gap of bg. Focus is never orange: orange means selected.

tokens.name: series
tokens.usage: Series badge fill; text on it is brand-white (6.2:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: 'In library' and 'Downloaded' status text and icons.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors: playback failed, server unreachable.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the detail dialog and the player controls; also the bottom fade on hero backdrops.

styles.name: web-display
styles.usage: Hero title; scale down with clamp(32px, 5vw, 48px).

styles.name: web-h2
styles.usage: Calendar day headings, wall month headings.

styles.name: web-body
styles.sample: A retired cartographer finds a map of a city that does not exist.
styles.usage: Overviews in the dialog, running text.

styles.name: web-body-sm
styles.usage: Card overview (clamped to 3 lines), meta lines.

styles.name: web-caption
styles.usage: Badges, tooltips, footer. Use tabular figures for dates.

styles.name: tv-display
styles.usage: Hero title, two lines at most.

styles.name: tv-body
styles.sample: A retired cartographer finds a map of a city that does not exist.
styles.usage: Hero and dialog overview, at most 4 lines.

styles.name: tv-label
styles.usage: Hero date and kicker, uppercase. The smallest TV size.

styles.name: tv-caption
styles.usage: Poster captions and badges. Nothing on TV is set below 24px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gap, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner gap, button vertical padding x 1.2.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, web side gutter on phones, poster gap on web.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section gap on web, TV poster gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Web side gutter on desktop, TV shelf title to posters.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between calendar days, between TV shelves.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding on desktop, TV dialog padding.

tokens.name: tv-safe-x
tokens.usage: TV left and right safe area (5% of 1920). Nothing readable or focusable outside it.

tokens.name: tv-safe-y
tokens.usage: TV top and bottom safe area (5% of 1080).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, progress bar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Posters and wall tiles (web and TV).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, the filter panel, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the player control bar, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, segmented controls, TV actions. Rounded like the play symbol's corners.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles at rest (web).

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Dialog, toast, tooltip, focused TV poster.

duration.note: Motion timing. Respect prefers-reduced-motion on web; TV keeps focus moves under 200 ms so the remote never feels laggy.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, chip toggle, focus ring.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: TV focus scale, tooltip, segmented thumb.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Dialog and player overlay in and out, shelf scroll.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that enters or moves into focus.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Overlays leaving.

tokens.name: tv-focus-scale
tokens.usage: Focused TV poster grows by 6% around its centre; neighbours do not move.
